body:
BUG-2569 is reproduced and the fix sketch is on the spec (aida comment list BUG-2569); it needs your signoff before I write gate code.

Cause in one line: the train merge step judges a member against every spec id in its car body (45 for promotion #3966), and a refusal recorded for an unrelated PR under one of those ids (BUG-2531, BUG-b6b-286) vetoes the carry-over; the member gate only looks at branch and title ids. Fix: (A) a verdict bound to another change counts only at the head being judged; (B) the member gate uses the same id set as the merge step. One question in the sketch: keep the same-head exception in A (my recommendation) or not.

While I wait I am starting BUG-2570, then BUG-2555. #3981 is at c901aa5143a awaiting the scoped re-review; integration is at a0b7db7e63c.
subject: BUG-2569 sketch needs signoff
